paragraphs: R. Yishmael ben Satriel (in Yalkut, Job, §39: Katriel), of Arkatta deLivna (Rashi explains: a place). He testified before Rabbi: the ḥazeret [plant, provisionally lettuce] in our locality has six hundred thousand leaves; likewise a gnat in its omasum. A cedar fell in his locality, and seventeen wagons passed over its pointed end. Once a bar yokhni's egg fell and flooded sixty cities, Bekhorot (57b).
